incoming.name: Omega-3 fatty acid
incoming.excerpt: …peanut (no omega-3), grapeseed oil (almost no omega-3) and corn oil 46 to 1 ratio of omega-6s to omega-3s.

outgoing.name: Maize
outgoing.excerpt: Corn oil is oil extracted from the germ of corn (maize).

outgoing.name: Textile
outgoing.excerpt: Other industrial uses for corn oil include soap, salve, paint, rustproofing for metal surfaces, inks, textiles, and insecticides.
